Buuz 2.0: A continuation of Buuz by Нямцэрэнгийн Одбаяр. Open source.
One click adds Mongolian (Buuz) to your keyboards.
Or add it yourself: Settings, Time and language, Language and region, Mongolian, Options, Add a keyboard, Buuz.
Ctrl + Space: Buuz on and off
Click the box and type. Buuz must be the active keyboard.
With э, ө or ү in a word, o becomes ө and u becomes ү.
Need ө or ү right now
q gives ө, w gives ү, ' gives ь, " gives ъ.
Find Buuz in the taskbar as МОН.
Switch key and q = ө, w = ү
Start the settings helper when Windows starts
Buuz is off. Add it again.
q = ө, w = ү, ' = ь, " = ъ
